wall.card.armor.d: ‎+35% damage to armored enemies and the boss
wall.card.wall.d: Instantly repairs 12% of the wall's HP
wall.card.sentry.d: Absorbs the first sniper shot every wave
wall.card.burn.d: Hits ignite — the enemy keeps burning
wall.card.frost.d: Hits freeze — the enemy slows down
wall.card.chain.d: Hits jump to a nearby enemy
wall.card.blast.d: Every kill sets off a small explosion
wall.card.pierce.d: Passes through one more enemy and ignores armor
wall.card.tracer.d: Damage grows the longer the burst lasts
wall.card.fuse.d: The bomb drops fast — hits before they can move
wall.card.napalm.d: The explosion leaves a burning pool of fire
wall.card.guided.d: The bomb is drawn to the nearest enemy on the way down
wall.card.shock.d: The explosion pushes enemies back from the wall
wall.card.tank.d: ‎+25% fuel capacity — more time in the air
wall.near_miss: {s} more seconds and you'd have survived wave {wave}! 😩
wall.end.title: The Wall 🏰 you held until wave {wave}!
wall.role.heli.d: Drag to fly — bombs drop on their own. Fuel burns in the air: come back to the wall to refuel!
wall.role.archer.d: Touch and hold on the target — the archer fires on his own. Move your finger to aim
wall.role.cannon.d: Aim and release — an area shell. Every shell is a decision
wall.role.mg.d: Hold and drag to spray bullets across the field. Watch the heat!
wall.hint.heli: 🕹️ Drag to fly — bombs drop on their own · ⛽ Fuel burns in the air, drop to the wall to refuel · 🎯 Dodge the anti-aircraft fire
wall.hint.archer: 👆 Touch and hold on an enemy — the archer fires on his own · Move your finger to aim
wall.hint.cannon: 🎯 Drag to aim, release — boom! Every shell is a decision
wall.hint.mg: 👆 Hold and drag left–right — sprays the whole field · Keep an eye on the heat gauge
wall.affix.roof: 🏠 Fortified roof — bombs don't work on it! Ground roles, it's on you
wall.affix.healer: 💚 Healer — heals the swarm! Take it down first
wall.affix.shield: 🌀 Kinetic shield — only sustained fire breaks it!
wall.sniper_you: 🎯 A sniper locked on you!! (Archers — save them!)
wall.fuel_out: ⛽ Out of fuel — drop to the wall to refuel!
wall.fuel_low: ⛽ Fuel running low — start heading back to the wall!
wall.pick_role_sub: The waves get stronger — the team needs every role. Duplicates are fine!
wall.host_starts: The host is starting the battle...
wall.host_decides: The host decides: another battle or the ceremony... 👀
